projects.name: NVIDIA ASPIRE
projects.robot_scope: Simulation embodiments and real dual-arm YAM are distinct. Each selected source identifies its domain; no cross-embodiment or physical compatibility was tested.

requirements.python: Use the pinned pyproject and benchmark-specific environments; BEHAVIOR uses Python 3.11.
packages: ASPIRE cap-harness from this exact checkout
Benchmark/provider extras, submodules and assets under separate terms
requirements.display: Simulation provider stack requires NVIDIA CUDA, perception/planner services and gated SAM3 access. Real YAM needs station calibration, CAN motor servers, cameras and matching hardware; --allow-motion is an upstream actuation interlock. No GPU, weights, provider or robot was provisioned.
